_comment: Curated reference releases for C4 and C5. Each entry is a judgement about which served owl:Ontology is a version of which published ontology; review before adding. Release files are read from the tagged tree, because older releases have no assets. Sources checked 2026-09-23.

ontologies.name: MWO
ontologies._evidence: MWO v3.0.1 declares the ontology IRI .../mwo/mwo.owl, v3.0.2 declares .../mwo (mwo.ttl at both tags); the MatWerk endpoint serves .../mwo/mwo.owl with versionIRI .../mwo.owl/3.0.1.
